plugins.name: outsystems
plugins.description: Edit, publish, deploy, and search OutSystems apps, and manage external libraries, from your AI assistant. Connects to your own OutSystems tenant's MCP server over OAuth.

plugins.name: legacy-modernization
plugins.description: [Limited availability] Modernize legacy applications onto OutSystems on a live ODC tenant: extract the requirements from legacy sources (/extract-requirements), build and verify the replacement app (/workflow-legacy-app), the /outsystems-app-generation light path, the migration close-out documents, the test evidence pack, and the planner, designer, developer, reviewer, tester and reporter roles. Uses the outsystems plugin's MCP server and its Mentor build skills.
